course.title: Materials Manufacturing Processes
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: You work in a manufacturing company that specializes in producing thin wire and sheet (10) products. Recently you have been assigned a project to develop a new fabrication procedure for a high strength metal alloy. The procedure involves extensive cold working to achieve the desired shape and dimensions. Considering the specific requirements of your project, choose a suitable heat treatment technique to restore ductility and prevent fracture in the production process and give proper reasoning(s) to your selection.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
